selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
train: python train_pancoll.py --model PanNet-in --dataset gf2 --device cuda:0 --max_hours 48 --eval_every 2000 --skip S_MS --tag _skipS_MS --results_dir results_panbase
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method PanNet --arm s_ms --train-set gf2 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PanNet/s_ms/gf2_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method PanNet --arm s_ms --train-set gf2 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PanNet/s_ms/gf2_full
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
